summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of PrivyAlgo WallStreet Terminal Turkish landing page. All 11 features in scope verified successfully on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Page loads with zero console errors. All data-testid selectors resolve, all hrefs correct, navbar smooth-scroll works for all three sections, mobile hamburger toggles the menu, footer disclaimer and 2026 PrivyAlgo AI copyright present.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar mobile menu CTA href='#cta' (id='cta' lives on Hero CTA wrapper). Works because the id exists, but the same id is shared on desktop nav CTA - consider distinct anchor for the CTA so deep-link target is unambiguous.

Technology.jsx uses `data-testid=tech-stat-${label}` where label contains spaces/slashes (e.g., 'Opsiyon kontratı / saniye'). Functional but not the cleanest selector convention; slug ids would be safer for future tests.

Hero headline renders without space between 'Mekaniklerini' and 'Yeniden Tanımla.' when textContent is read (due to
). Visual rendering is correct; only relevant for tests using string equality. Not a defect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Turkish marketing page at '/'. No backend, no auth, no forms. All data-testid attributes from review request exist and resolve. Verified: landing-page, navbar (logo+links features/technology/community + CTA 'Sisteme Eriş'), hero-headline (Piyasa Mekaniklerini / Yeniden Tanımla.), hero-cta-primary 'Sisteme Eriş', hero-cta-secondary 'Eğitimleri İzle' linking to https://www.youtube.com/@NFinans, hero-terminal + hero-surface, all 4 feature-card-* (opus-wall/greeks/0dte/interval), all 4 partner-* (ThetaData/Alpaca API/Deribit/Yahoo Finance), social-youtube/twitter/instagram with exact required hrefs, footer (© 2026 PrivyAlgo AI + Finansal Risk Uyarısı disclaimer), navbar-link clicks scroll through sections (Y=1279->2896->3692), mobile-toggle opens mobile menu with all links + CTA. Zero console errors across viewports.
